== Revised Dagobah white-border face ==
The published white-border image [http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/dagobah/dark/images/badfeelinghaveiwb.gif badfeelinghaveiwb.gif], Decipher’s Dagobah card list. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010829203651id_/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/dagobah/dark/images/badfeelinghaveiwb.gif Internet Archive], captured 29 August 2001. supports this printing’s image and game text.
The printed instruction includes “are each deploy +2”; the source punctuation is retained.
Existing page names, identifiers and family navigation are preserved.
